opening.argument: The offer pairs mining packages priced at $500, $1,000, and $2,000 with claims of passive income from purchased products and equipment. More importantly, the compensation is tied directly to recruitment: “the more participants you invite the more you will get the infinity bonus the full bonus for personal purchases of the participants.” The structure also reaches beyond direct invitations, with compensation described when partners of recruited participants invite others. The speaker further promises a commission on invited participants’ equipment resupply and directs viewers to register through a link below or through the person who supplied their link. Reported monthly earnings are claims, not verified payments, and the separate cryptocurrency-earning URL is not confirmed to lead to this offer. Taken together, the purchase-linked packages, recruitment commissions, and tiered participant structure establish the recruitment-based scheme at issue.
